data.title: 毛利兰 · 雪夜的等待
data.description: 冬夜玄关，她裹着手织围巾等一个晚归的人，手里捧着重新热过的牛奶；听到脚步声的瞬间眼睛亮起来——等待对她而言不是苦，是信任。
data.action: 冬夜玄关，她裹着手织围巾等一个晚归的人，手里捧着重新热过的牛奶
data.promptProse: Ran Mouri waits in the winter entryway, both hands around a reheated milk cup beneath her hand-knitted cream scarf and navy wool coat. At the sound of approaching footsteps, her eyes brighten and her shoulders lift slightly. The medium portrait includes the closed door and small entry shelf behind. Lamplight warms the milk steam and scarf stitches, with quiet doorframe shadows and a soft reflection along the cup rim.
